scope: Effective runtime overrides for short disposable performance updates. Profiling .py configs preserve unused embedded archive fields; only model and base optimizer fields are consumed.
model_config: F_stage3_e5 embedded model with all init_cfg/pretrained removed, strict full state load

optimizer.state: fresh and identical at every group/repeat
optimizer.lr_schedule: fixed configured base LR for profiling; no archived warm-up LR scheduler

data: Night local cache, empty GT inputs, 512 real keys with real adjacent references; model creates actual contrastive reference from key
APR_memory: 3 historical target domains, car label1, 100x256 FP32 per domain, score>=.75, topk3, .005 weight
timer: synchronized window boundaries; includes next(data), H2D, CPU FAP, actual teacher/student forward and loss, backward, optimizer and EMA; no profiler
